title: 航空構造設計Ⅱ
subtitle: Aircraft Structure Design II
educationalGoal: Students will learn (1) how to analyze the buckling load of thin flat plate (2) the concept of effective width flat plate with stiffeners (3) aircraft structural design under static loads (4) aircraft structural design under fatigue loads
advice: On the basis of knowledge learned in subjects such as Mechanics of Materials and Mechanics of Aircraft Structure, student will learn the advanced mechanics for aircraft structural design. We will cover the following materials: (1) Buckling of thin flat plate (2) Buckling and effective width of plate with stiffeners (3) Basic concepts of structural design methods under static loads (Strength ratio, Margin of safety) (4) Basic concepts of structural design methods under fatigue loads (Safe life design, Damage tolerance design) Students should thoroughly review what they have learned in Mechanics of Materials and Mechanics of Aircraft Structure before taking this course.
books: Basis of Understanding Strength of Materials -Second Edition, Kyoritsu Syuppan, 2013
requiredKnowledge: Basic knowledge of Mechanics of Materials and Mechanics of Aircraft Structure.

activityGoals.body: Be able to calculate buckling load of thin flat plates
Be able to understand the concept of effective width and calculate the effective width of plate with stiffeners
Be able to explain the meanings of 'limit load' and 'ultimate load'
Be able to evaluate the static strength of aircraft structure using strength ratio or margin of safety
Regarding the fatigue strength of aircraft structures, be able to explain the concept of damage tolerance design

achievementLevels.ideal: (1)Calculate the buckling load of a flat plate under various constraint conditions (2)Fully understand the concept of effective width and accurately calculate the effective width of plate with stiffeners (3)Evaluate the static strength of aircraft structures using the strength factor or margin of safety. Utilize these to improve structural design (4)Understand the concept of fracture mechanics. Explain the concept of damage tolerance design in regard to fatigue strength of aircraft structures
achievementLevels.standard: (1)Calculate the buckling load of a flat plate simply supported at all edges (2)Explain the concept of effective width (3)Evaluate the strength of aircraft structures under static loads using the strength factor or margin of safety (4)Calculate the crack growth behavior under fatigue load and evaluate the residual strength
